definitions:
Informal name of various plants with poisonous berries, most commonly nightshades:
Deadly nightshade.
Bittersweet nightshade, Solanum dulcamara.
Plants in the genus Cestrum: Cestrum nocturnum, Cestrum parqui.
Any other berry of a plant in the nightshade family, Solanaceae, most of which are poisonous at least when unripe.
Bluebead lily (Clintonia borealis).
Pokeweed.

blocks.text: Poisonberry is a common name of many species of plant:

items: Actaea rubra, a herbaceous North American plant in buttercup family more often known as red baneberry
Bourreria succulenta, a tree native to the Caribbean
Cestrum ssp., warm temperate and tropical plants more often known as cestrums or jessamines
Clintonia borealis, herbaceous plant native to North America more often known as bluebead
Solanum dulcamara, a Eurasian plant more often known as bittersweet nightshade
